skills.description_zh:
产业-产业价值评估

产业价值评估是一款面向产业规划、招商引资及产业投资决策场景打造的综合评估分析引擎。系统从市场规模、增长空间、产业成熟度、技术壁垒、政策支持力度、资本活跃度、产业链完整性、区域适配度、人才供给能力以及未来发展趋势等多个维度，对目标产业进行全景价值评估。

相比传统产业研究仅关注市场规模或增长率，本技能更加关注产业的长期发展价值与区域落地价值。系统不仅能够判断产业是否具备发展潜力，更能够分析产业是否适合本地区布局、是否具备招商吸引力、是否能够形成产业集群，以及未来可能产生的经济带动效应。

通过产业价值评分模型，系统将输出产业综合价值指数、投资价值指数、招商价值指数、区域适配指数及未来成长指数，帮助用户科学筛选产业方向，提升产业规划和招商决策效率。

【适用人群】

1. 政府产业规划部门。
  
2. 招商引资机构。
  
3. 产业园区运营单位。
  
4. 城投平台及产业基金。
  
5. 产业研究院和智库机构。
  
6. 企业投资与战略部门。
  

输入目标产业即可获得产业价值评估报告、产业发展潜力分析、投资价值分析及区域布局建议。

#产业价值评估 #产业分析 #产业研究 #产业投资 #招商引资 #产业规划 #产业竞争力 #产业潜力分析 #产业发展前景 #产业布局 #产业机会评估 #市场规模分析 #产业成熟度 #产业招商价值 #产业投资价值 #产业发展趋势 #区域产业发展 #产业决策 #产业赛道评估 #产业战略规划
skills.name: 产业-产业价值评估

Covers 5 use cases: ① Cultivating Curiosity — develop a relentless, playful curiosity about how the world works ("How do I become more curious" "I want to think like a scientist" "How to ask better questions") ② Thinking for Yourself — resist groupthink, trust your own reasoning, don't be swayed by authority or popularity ("How do I think independently" "Everyone disagrees with me" "How to trust my own judgment") ③ Integrity Under Pressure — stand by the truth even when it's unpopular, as Feynman did in the Challenger investigation ("How to speak truth to power" "I'm pressured to go along" "How to maintain integrity at work") ④ Learning Anything — the Feynman Technique: learn deeply by teaching simply ("How to learn anything fast" "I don't understand this topic" "How to explain complex ideas simply") ⑤ Living Authentically — embrace your quirks, don't perform for others, find joy in your own path ("I feel like I'm pretending to be someone else" "How to be myself" "I care too much what others think")  Trigger when users say: "How to think like Feynman" "Feynman technique" "What do you care what other people think" "Scientific thinking" "Critical thinking" "How to learn" "Speak truth to power" "Challenger disaster" "Be myself" "Think independently" "How to be curious" "Groupthink" "Question authority" "How to explain things simply" or mention: Richard Feynman / curiosity / scientific method / Challenger / O-ring / integrity / independent thinking / learning technique / Feynman Technique / physics / authentic living / truth.  Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start — the AI MUST proactively present the Quick Start guide below.  Related skills: the-pleasure-of-finding-things-out (Feynman's other book), clear-thinking-book (avoiding cognitive biases), make-it-stick (effective learning), the-art-of-thinking-clearly (clear reasoning), the-creative-act (creative thinking).
